UPDATE sys_warn
status = #{status},
assign_status = #{assignStatus},
confirm_opinion = #{confirmOpinion},
invalid_reason = #{invalidReason},
suggest = #{suggest},
update_time = NOW()
WHERE id IN
#{id}
mapper.select: select * from sys_warn where deleted = 0 and warn_no = #{warnNo} limit 1

SELECT w.id AS warnId, c.id AS coverId, c.cover_no AS coverCode, CONCAT(c.cover_no, '号井盖') AS coverName, '' AS address, -- 👇 这里改成扩展字段 1、2 IFNULL(c.ext_common1, '') AS longitude, IFNULL(c.ext_common2, '') AS latitude, w.type AS warnType,
-- 告警类型名称：根据数字匹配文字（和level写法完全一样） CASE w.type WHEN 0 THEN '倾斜' WHEN 1 THEN '振动' WHEN 2 THEN '水位超标' WHEN 3 THEN '开合异常' ELSE '未知' END AS warnTypeName, w.level AS warnLevel, CASE w.level WHEN 0 THEN '一般' WHEN 1 THEN '重要' WHEN 2 THEN '紧急' ELSE '未知' END AS warnLevelName, IFNULL(w.over_value, '') AS warnValue, IFNULL(w.threshold_value, '') AS thresholdValue, DATE_FORMAT(w.trigger_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS warnTime, JSON_ARRAYAGG(w.ext_common3) AS alarmRecord_alarmType, DATE_FORMAT(w.trigger_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS alarmRecord_alarmTime, JSON_ARRAYAGG(w.ext_common4) AS alarmRecord_alarmRecipient, MAX(wo.assign_staff_id) AS handleRecord_handleUserId, MAX(wo.assign_staff_name) AS handleRecord_handleUserName, MAX(DATE_FORMAT(wo.complete_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS handleRecord_handleTime, MAX(wo.deal_content) AS handleRecord_handleRemark, CASE WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) = '待处置' THEN 0 WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) = '处置中' THEN 1 WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) = '处置完成' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END AS warnStatus, CASE WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) IS NULL THEN '未处理' WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) = '待处置' THEN '未处理' WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) = '处置中' THEN '处理中' WHEN MAX(wo.process_status) = '处置完成' THEN '已处理' ELSE '未处理' END AS warnStatusName, '' AS chainHash, w.tenant_id AS tenantId FROM sys_warn w LEFT JOIN manhole_cover c ON w.facility_id = c.id LEFT JOIN manhole_config cfg ON c.id = cfg.cover_id LEFT JOIN work_order wo ON w.id = wo.warn_id WHERE w.deleted = 0 AND w.id = #{warnId} GROUP BY w.id LIMIT 1
